source_title: Como Registrar Mi Cuenta Bancaria Para Retiros Fuera De Brasil
snippet_primary: "Tu cuenta bancaria debe estar registrada en el mismo país donde resides. No es posible registrar cuentas bancarias de países diferentes a los que están registrados en la plataforma."
subject_exact: Hotmart bank account registration help center (help.hotmart.com/es, as of April 2026) states the registered bank account must be in the same country where the seller resides; registering bank accounts from countries different from the platform registration country is not possible
local_qualifiers: Hotmart help (as of Apr 2026): bank account must be in same country as residence; cross-country bank accounts not accepted
parser_notes: help.hotmart.com (as of Apr 2026). Spanish. Bank account must match residence country. Consistent with Gumroad's similar residency requirement.
